title: Period calculation
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the period T using T = λ/v, obtaining 0.4 s.

title: Time to first crest
description: Essential: Correctly calculates the time for the crest to first reach P using Δt = Δx/v, obtaining 1/15 s or 0.0667 s.

title: Wave propagation distance
description: Important: Correctly calculates the distance the wave travels in 1.1 s (Δx = v * t = 6.6 m).

title: Phase analysis for direction
description: Important: Determines the new phase/position of particle P after 1.1 s by analyzing the wave's propagation (e.g., 2 full wavelengths + 1.8 m).

title: Vibration direction determination
description: Essential: Correctly states the vibration direction of P at t=1.1 s as positive y (upward).

title: Misidentifying particle motion
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assumes particle P travels with the wave speed or confuses transverse particle motion with wave propagation.

title: Sign/direction error
description: Pitfall: States the vibration direction at t=1.1 s as negative y (downward) or gives an incorrect sign for the time to first crest.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: Maintains consistent units (m, s, cm) throughout calculations and conversions.
